about: Error probabilities of the six tutorial sites estimated from S draws simulated in the browser (engine gaussianDraws, seeded), beside their exact values (errorArray). Expected values: the frozen v1 registry, whose P-09 keys were written for exactly these settings (six.A.mcse.AB.S1000: the MCSE of A–B from the trace of the S = 1,000 draws at seed 1, τ .20; cf.envelope.*: the envelope radii at M 15 and failure chance .05, postrank's form and the book's; six.A.e.*: exact error probabilities; six.A.cap3.tau20.*, six.A.all.tau20.* and six.AB.w50.cap3.tau20.*: the exact report with at most 3 grades or among all reports, as the cap key sets); postrank 1.1.0 golden rows (postrank_mc_fragility() on the engine's own draws at seeds 20261030 and 20261031, given in the rows to nine decimals, and postrank_iid_bounds() at S 1,000); and base-R oracle rows (fragility at S 200, seed 424242; the envelope radii, the book's form over two scores; the exact optimum's family size). The ordinary runs-panel sentences on flips and ties are checked word for word; independent base-R oracle-v3-review-a rows now pin both boundary-seed rerun sets, their spread, coverage, pair actions and report tallies. oracle-v3p1 rows pin the exact-e approximation (binomialMcse at A–B's exact error, S 100, 1,000 and 4,000). Literals: the teaching-posterior and Monte Carlo captions (6.5, v3 wording).
